summary: Full matrix validation of PART 1: DELETE /api/orders/{id} + Orders.jsx delete UI + Logo rendering fix. Backend: full regression + new delete test file (test_order_delete.py) via pytest-xdist = 59 passed, 1 skipped (delivery-geocoding, unchanged). All delete rules verified via API: admin DELETE completed/cancelled -> 200 {message:'Bestelling verwijderd'}, subsequent GET -> 404; admin DELETE active (new/accepted/preparing/ready) -> 400 with exact Dutch detail 'Alleen afgeronde of geannuleerde bestellingen kunnen worden verwijderd.' and order remains; staff DELETE cancelled -> 403, order remains; customer status-token URL returns 404 after delete (statusTokenHash lookup finds nothing); orderNumber counter is strictly monotonic across a delete+new-order sequence (never reused/reset); unknown/foreign order id -> 404 (tenant filter {_id, restaurantId}). Frontend verified end-to-end: admin on /dashboard/bestellingen 'Geannuleerd' filter shows order-delete-{n}; clicking opens delete-dialog-{n}; delete-cancel keeps the card; delete-confirm removes it (toast + list refresh); 'Actief' filter shows zero delete buttons across 94 cards; staff role sees ZERO delete buttons on both 'Geannuleerd' (12 cards) and 'Afgerond' (15 cards). Logo fix verified: with logo cleared, sidebar renders data-testid='upxero-logo' (fallback brand, 2 instances = desktop sidebar + mobile header); after PUT /api/restaurant/profile with https://images.unsplash.com/... the sidebar renders data-testid='restaurant-logo' with correct src and no 'upxero-logo' present, and the public /order/bistro-demo page header also renders data-testid='restaurant-logo'. No pageerrors, no console errors (only expected 401 on /auth/me before login).
critical_code_review_comments: orders.py DELETE handler is tight: fetches with {_id, restaurantId}, 404 on miss, 400 on non-deletable status, delete_one re-asserts restaurantId -> safe against race/foreign tenant.
Error message is exactly the Dutch string specified by the problem statement; stable to assert in tests and UX copy.
Deletion uses db.orders.delete_one; no counter decrement, so next_order_number (which $inc's db.counters) is naturally monotonic and never reuses an orderNumber.

public.order_status looks up by statusTokenHash only; because the entire order document is removed on delete, the token resolves nowhere -> 404 (confirmed in test_status_token_404_after_delete). No separate token-revocation table needed.

Logo.jsx: when src is truthy, renders inside the data-testid='restaurant-logo' container with an onError that hides the broken image. Fallback to data-testid='upxero-logo' when src is empty. Height h-9 + w-auto + max-w-[180px] preserves aspect ratio and prevents layout break — matches the spec.

Orders.jsx: canDelete = isAdmin && ['completed','cancelled'].includes(status) — correctly gates the Verwijderen button; AlertDialog testids are parametrized with orderNumber per spec; onDelete calls api.delete(`/orders/${id}`) and reloads list on success.

Minor (not blocking): Logo onError hides the but leaves the restaurant-logo wrapper
rendered — the parent gap-2 flex just collapses. If the logo URL is permanently broken the sidebar shows an empty 36px gap instead of falling back to the Upxero brand. Consider swapping to a stateful fallback (useState for imgError -> render upxero-logo) in a future iteration.

seed_data_creation: During tests created several orders via POST /api/public/restaurant/bistro-demo/orders (orderNumbers in 1130s). All test-created orders were cancelled and then DELETEd as cleanup except where delete was the subject-under-test; one UI-exercised order (#1139) was permanently deleted via the UI delete flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DELETE /api/orders/{id} is live and strict. Admin role is checked via require_roles('restaurant_admin'). Dashboard route is /dashboard/bestellingen; delete UI uses data-testid='order-delete-{orderNumber}' / 'delete-dialog-{n}' / 'delete-confirm-{n}' / 'delete-cancel-{n}'. Logo wired in Logo.jsx (optional `src` prop) and used by OrderPage header (src={restaurant.logo}) and DashboardLayout sidebar + mobile header (src={restaurant?.logo}). Auth is cookie-based (httpOnly) + bearer token; to switch roles in Playwright, call `await page.context.clear_cookies()` BEFORE navigating to /login. urllib default UA can get 403 on some endpoints — always pass a Mozilla UA header for /api calls from Python/urllib. Uploads (parts 2–4 of the task) are NOT implemented yet and were intentionally not tested.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All delete rules, tenant isolation, status-link invalidation, counter integrity, UI gating, and logo rendering behave as specified.
